hypotheses.H_B0_skill: each model account's probability beats the market mid: per-event mean log loss (model - mid) on the scored strikes, Diebold-Mariano (forecast_eval.dm_test), t < 0 and two-sided p / 2 <= skill_p. PRED-GATED is scored with p_cal (the frozen calibration), PRED-LIT8 with p_raw. A fail is REJECT for that account whatever its P&L
hypotheses.H_B1_gated: PRED-GATED (the guide's BOOK with QUANTGEN's calibrated GARCH-t and a 2x-fee binary cost gate) earns more than 0 per $
hypotheses.H_B2_lit8: PRED-LIT8 (the guide as written: 8-point gap on the raw model) earns more than 0 per $
hypotheses.H_B3_flb: PRED-FLB (no model: the favourite nearest 93c) earns more than 0 per $
hypotheses.model: GARCH(1,1)-t (core.quant.garch.fit_garch) on the last 2,000 hourly BTCUSDT log returns divided by their hour-of-day x weekend RMS, fed at x 0.01. An event's model is skipped (and counted toward max_skip) on a parameter bound (alpha, beta, omega, nu), a missing last bar, or a fit that did not converge UNLESS it carries garch.py's 'stationarity' flag (alpha + beta > 0.995): such fits are used. On the 2026 archive these were mostly stops on the 0.9995 penalty wall, plus a minority of interior stalls between 0.9967 and 0.9989 whose sigma lies within 0.93-1.06x of a refit with the cap relaxed (owner's ruling 2026-10-22, before the freeze)
hypotheses.nulls: model accounts must beat the coin-flip side on the same strike (paired, p <= null_p); PRED-GATED must also beat PRED-FLB on 5-day block means (p <= null_p); NB0 (the market mid as forecast) is the skill bar
hypotheses.sample: every KXBTCD event whose decision (close - 30 min) is after frozen_utc and whose close is before 2027-02-01; blinded (fetched, never replayed) until then; one look, by the first full grokteam.book run at or after 2027-02-01 01:00 UTC with every forward event fetched, written once to out/book/FORWARD_LOOK.json; never extended
hypotheses.test: mean per-bet return, cluster-robust SE over 5-day UTC blocks, one-sided p from t(G - 1); Holm across the three accounts at holm_alpha
hypotheses.unit: net return per $ of premium (fee included) of each bet on the fixed $60 shadow book; the $1,000 path is reported, not tested
hypotheses.verdicts: REJECT: skill failed, or the 90% interval lies below 0. PAPER-CANDIDATE: Holm p <= holm_alpha, the 90% interval above 0, the 2x-fee + 1-cent stress mean above 0, and the nulls beaten. INVALID: model skip rate above max_skip. Else INCONCLUSIVE. Reported with every verdict, never gated: MDE = mde_factor x sd / sqrt(n) and N* = ceil((mde_factor x sd / target_edge)^2) (at the 1% target the forward window cannot reach N*). validate.GATE is not run: it needs five years, so PAPER-CANDIDATE is the ceiling
